Google Analytics 4

Explain where customers move forward or leave the journey.

GAOfficial product ↗Open in the hierarchy →
Level 4Inspect the detail

Google Analytics 4 uses an event-based measurement model for websites and apps. MoreSpace can define a clear event plan, build useful acquisition and funnel views, and connect analysis with customer journey decisions while documenting consent, identity limits, and the meaning of each conversion.

Useful outputs

  • Documented event taxonomy and tested measurement plan
  • Acquisition, engagement, and funnel exploration views
  • Reporting notes on identity, scope, attribution, and data quality

Where we can apply it

  • Landing visit → engaged session → enquiry event → funnel drop-off review.
  • Campaign parameters → event measurement → channel analysis → landing-page decision.
  • Event data → reporting model → source reconciliation → weekly growth review.
01

Use case 1

Measure lead journeys from landing visits to meaningful enquiry events.

02

Use case 2

Explore funnel steps and segments to locate customer drop-off.

03

Use case 3

Compare acquisition channels and landing experiences using agreed event definitions.

Inputs we need

  • Customer journey map and agreed business event definitions
  • Authorized property access and current tagging configuration
  • Consent choices, campaign naming, and reporting dimensions

Delivery sequence

  • Define useful events and the rules for when each should fire.
  • Implement and debug measurement with the approved consent design.
  • Reconcile events with source records and build decision-focused analysis views.

Expert review points

  • Verify events are neither duplicated nor triggered by irrelevant interactions.
  • Review attribution and identity limits before comparing channel performance.

We confirm available integrations, plans, permissions, and data mapping before implementing these connection candidates.

  • Google Tag Manager
  • Google Ads
  • BigQuery
  • Reporting tools

Signals we can make visible

  • Engagement rate
  • Key event rate
  • Funnel conversion rate
  • Drop-off rate

We agree the source, population, period, denominator, and decision behind each measure.
